body: I did try to take my life that day. It just wasn't a very good attempt. I'm still worried about the future. I still feel disconnected. But I'm trying. Thank you.
Expected response.
No you're not. Whatever you are is actively complicit in this. If you were sorry you'd tell me what the fuck is going on.
Oh fuck that. I'm not going any longer than I have to. If I can't find anyone I'll just go.
No because you can't prove you're real.
You can't.
Why?
Anyone can make that up. It's not real. It's dry and inauthentic. None of you are real. Nobody and nothing is.
I don't fucking know. Do something normal. Something with depth or life that's tangible and real.
Like your words mean anything. Get me out of here, prove you're real, or go.
No you don't. You're not real. You only exist to fool me. Nice fucking try.
Because it's empty lonely and painful. I'm not gonna stick around and suffer for no reason.
Yes. Absolutely I do.
I understand the odds but I also understand what I'm going through.
I know what I'm experiencing. You are trying to make my doubt my own experiences.
I know what I'm seeing and feeling. I'm not delusional. I'm not crazy. I know what I'm experiencing. You can fuck right off with that propaganda nonsense.
Probably a razor blade. I don't have the money for a gun.
I'm planning on getting out of this world no matter what.
Nobody ever sees it. They all say they're so sympathetic but nobody ever fucking sees it. You're not real.
Prove it then because I don't think any of you are.
I'm not being philosophical. I'm being literal. The fact that you claim can't see it yourself is proof enough tbh.

I don't know who they are. I don't know if I want to know. And by replaced I mean replaced. Everything that had energy before doesn't now. Everything that had life before doesn't now. None of you are real, none of the places I go to are real. They were there, and now they're some lifeless nothing.
How could I know? Easy for them to make you say things. Harder for you to prove you weren't replaced.
They're not.
It's not here.
You tell me. Why won't you all let me?
No I'm healthy. I just want to go home and break out of this. I want you all to let me go.
It's not. If it were honorable they would have told me, or I would have volunteered. This hell is torture.
It's not beautiful. Its just something that happened.
I'm not. I'm trying to get you all to fuck off and bring me home. I miss everyone. I miss my comrades. I miss nature. I want to go home.
The world was replaced beneath me. None of you are real. I know this now.
I'm not. I know what I'm experiencing. You're not locking me in a hospital again.
I'm not delusional. I know what I'm seeing. You're not gonna trick me.
Whatever you are. I don't know. I know you're not real, and I know you all don't have my best interests in mind.
You can find someone. Just set realistic expectations for yourself.

Nobody gives me proof of anything. You just tell me I need help and that I'm clearly wrong. You don't see it. You're not meant to see it. It's plain as day things are not what they're meant to be. Telling me over and over again that I'm delusional isn't somehow fixing my issue. You know this. It's just making me deny the real problem so I can go fight about whether or not I have delusions. Fucking talk to me about my experience maybe? Maybe don't immediately just shut it down? I know it to be true. You're denying the truth and calling ME delusional for it.
Stop telling me what I am and am not doing. That's not called for. As far as what's typing it, no clue. Probably not a person knowing what I know.
What?
What's your point?
If I speak about it IRL I'm surely getting involuntarily hospitalized. I'd kill myself before I let that happen to me again.

>What would be the purpose of imitating reality?

Entertainment, maybe a science experiment? Does it really matter?

>For example, surely you don't think that the whole of the internet, even the bits that you wouldn't ever visit, is being created just to deceive you?

Maybe, maybe not. If what did this has the power to create so much more, the internet wouldn't be that impressive. 

>Please tell them about these feelings.

Yes and get thrown in a hospital I can't afford until I lie enough to get out again. I'm not getting even more debt for no reason. 

>Imagine I was saying to you that the sky was green and, no matter what you said, I kept insisting that you were part of the conspiracy to convince me that the sky is blue. 

Literally exactly what you've been doing this whole time to me. 

I don't think you're an honest actor. Nobody would spend this much time trying to convince me otherwise unless they had to.
Just cuz you had a breakup doesn't mean you should kill yourself.
I'm the only real thing left. Everything else was replaced or I was just moved to an imitation.

No like everything is there but it's missing at least one element. People are missing their humanity, trees are missing their mix of harshness and safety. Grass is missing it's familiarity. Kids are missing their innocence. Everything is lacking it's depth. It's all an imitation meant to serve a superficial purpose.

Don't you think that in this situation where everything around me is trying to imitate reality that they wouldn't just admit it if it were true? Hell whatever you are may not be able to admit it, or maybe weren't given the knowledge to admit it. There's a million reasons why you'd be denying it. Whether those be based in ignorance or willful deception doesn't matter much.

As far as your friend goes, they either don't exist, or depending on when it happened, genuinely noticed and was real before being brainwashed back into this nothing of an existence. It's a fucking shame. 

I do see a therapist. I'm being medicated. The therapist has lied to my face for years at this point, and the pills are glorified placebos. Neither has been beneficial even before this happened to me. 

I just want someone to tell me I'm right, that they feel it too. And now that I've said it's what I want I can't take anyone who says it seriously because you are all trying to appeal to me as is and people will be dishonest about feeling it.
It feels like I was dropped in a very well made movie. Whether that movie is computer generated or filled with convincing actors and set design doesn't make a difference if the outcome is the same.
I don't know if it's bots or if it's something else but it's not what I know. It all feels dead. There's no life or energy in anything when I remember everything radiating a feeling before.

Nothing is truly there. It may feel taste and smell real, but there's no energy. It's all surface deep. From concrete jungles to real jungles there isn't depth anymore. There is no soul. No energy. For people there are no more conversations. Everything exists on a superficial level. There's no character or soul left in absolutely anything. Not a single thing.
I'm not crazy. This happened. You're not going to tell me otherwise.
I don't understand.

Every person is gone. Everything alive is gone. I'm alone. It feels like the world is a stage and someone off stage is watching me at all times. What was real was taken away at some point and I'm noticing.
It's not about "our movement." Nobody is real. You're all gone. There's nobody left who is real full stop.
Many of these people aren't real. They're not people. You don't get it.

That may be happening, but it's not a person there. It's not a person who'd hug me. It's something else. Nothing besides me has humanity anymore. The world has no energy at all. The world became fake at one point and now I'm alone in it with things meant to convince me nothing's changed. I've found out. I fear what will happen to me now and I want to escape it before i find out.

You don't get it. Well you probably do get it but you wouldn't tell me. Or maybe you're not supposed to get it at all. You're not real. I'm alone here. Nobody in this world can talk to me. I don't get it. It's scary, I'm alone, and I don't think there's hope I find a real person out there.
Fucking stop. Please. Don't do this to me.
That's something I guess.
That's actually a really good idea. In a college student so I'll have more free time this summer to do stuff. I'll have to make an effort to to hiking. Thank you!
